item.title: Open letter to Orion Corporation re JoongAng Ilbo
item.description: Read a statement from the Global Intrinsic Value team to the Board of Orion Corporation.

item.title: Convertibles deserve a fresh look
item.description: Balanced convertibles are once again delivering meaningful equity participation while outpacing investment grade credit. Davide Basile, Portfolio Manager, Redwheel Convertible Bonds, argues that convertibles have reached a turning point, read more in his latest insight.

item.title: Greenwheel insights – A framework for responsible investment in conflict-affected and high-risk areas
item.description: Greenwheel’s latest insights piece explores how investors should assess companies operating in conflict-affected and high-risk areas, using heightened human rights due diligence to identify, prioritise, and mitigate conflict and human rights risks. It argues that responsible business can also support stability, resilience, and peace-positive outcomes.

item.title: The return of the total return kings: There and back again
item.description: Despite persistent outflows, global investor underweights and little direct exposure to the AI-led market rally, UK equities have generated strong relative returns. Larry Furness, Redwheel Value & Income, examines how low valuations, share buybacks, takeover activity and the recovery in value stocks have contributed to that outcome.

item.title: Greenwheel insights – Double in a decade: The EU’s new electrification action plan
item.description: Europe remains heavily exposed to fossil fuel supply shocks, with energy import dependency higher than most other major global economies. Against this backdrop, the European Commission’s new Electrification Action Plan sets a highly ambitious indicative target to double electricity’s share of EU final energy consumption by 2040 and backs it with several proposed measures. Read the Greenwheel team's view on what this could mean for investors.

item.title: The big friendly trade
item.description: Redwheel’s Shaul Rosten looks at past market cycles to challenge the assumption that US equity dominance is here to stay. Read why he believes today’s valuations and market concentration could set the stage for a shift in leadership—and why his team’s value-investing lens points towards cheaper international markets.

item.title: Electricity stocks: Ready to bounce?
item.description: Ecofin Portfolio Manager Michel Sznajer examines his strategy’s performance after previous peaks in bond yields and identifies potential takeover targets amid falling valuations and improving earnings prospects. Read his latest insight on the investment case for the sector—and the risks that could keep it under pressure.

item.title: Greenwheel insights – The energy transition: metrics, expectations, and four structural tailwinds
item.description: The latest Greenwheel Insights paper argues that the transition is both more advanced and more resilient than current market sentiment suggests. It shows how renewables and electrification are already reshaping useful energy demand, driven by record clean energy investment and accelerating deployment in solar, storage and EVs.

item.title: Greenwheel insights – Distortion in the machine: Four new AI considerations for investors
item.description: Regulation is beginning to catch up to manage the risks posed by AI development and deployment. As China and the European Union continue to lead the way with innovative AI laws, some emerging markets are following suit in adopting a risk-based approach to AI regulation. In the United States, given the severe environmental and social impacts of data centres, some states are proposing bills to protect communities from absorbing the negative externalities of existing and new projects. Against this backdrop, this piece provides investors with a summary of the four key developments in AI.

item.title: When unusual events point to unusual times
item.description: Two holdings in the Redwheel Global Equity Income strategy have agreed to be acquired this year, while a third has attracted takeover speculation – rare for a strategy invested in large, liquid companies. Nick Clay, Portfolio Manager, considers what this may reveal about the opportunity in durable businesses overlooked by a market fixated on a single theme.

item.title: Open Letter to Gold Fields Limited re Northern Star
item.description: Read a statement from the Emerging & Frontier Markets team to the Board of Directors of Gold Fields Limited.

item.title: Greenwheel insights – Electricity systems in transition: Resiliency lessons from the Iberian blackout
item.description: New research from Redwheel’s Greenwheel team reviews a recent report on the April 2025 Iberian blackout. With 21 recommendations, it urges stronger grid investment, better renewable integration, and harmonised EU access rules under the forthcoming Grids Package.

item.title: Greenwheel insights – Heat beneath our feet: unlocking geothermal’s untapped potential
item.description: Growing electricity demand and security of supply concerns put geothermal energy in the solutions spotlight. Geothermal provides near‑zero‑emissions baseload and flexible power plus direct heat at stable operating costs, with minimal land footprint and no fuel inputs.
